notes.title: Important information
notes.content:
[b]Important information[/b]

Dear friends, unfortunately we have problems with optimization. We overzealous with AI and binaural sound. All our efforts are aimed at correcting, we will replace surround sound with a ready-made solution. We want to release a final and high-quality product. This weekend we will post screenshots and a trailer with a final release date. The game will be released in February, we will release it even if the day falls on the upcoming Steam Next Fest, to our detriment.

[b]Thank you for your understanding and patience.[/b] It's worth it. We ourselves are afraid to play this ***
